From 6e29464b8a72e74ec7c3f816f53bfe46a43601bc Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Nathan Chancellor <natechancellor@gmail.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Oct 2018 03:51:58 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] hinic: Fix l4_type parameter in hinic_task_set_tunnel_l4

Clang warns:

drivers/net/ethernet/huawei/hinic/hinic_tx.c:392:34: error: implicit
conversion from enumeration type 'enum hinic_l4_tunnel_type' to
different enumeration type 'enum hinic_l4_offload_type'
[-Werror,-Wenum-conversion]
                hinic_task_set_tunnel_l4(task, TUNNEL_UDP_NO_CSUM,
                ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~       ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
1 error generated.

It seems that hinic_task_set_tunnel_l4 was meant to take an enum of type
hinic_l4_tunnel_type, not hinic_l4_offload_type, given both the name of
the functions and the values used.

Fixes: cc18a7543d2f ("net-next/hinic: add checksum offload and TSO support")
Signed-off-by: Nathan Chancellor <natechancellor@gmail.com>
Reviewed-by: Nick Desaulniers <ndesaulniers@google.com>
Signed-off-by: David S. Miller <davem@davemloft.net>

diff --git a/drivers/net/ethernet/huawei/hinic/hinic_hw_qp.h b/drivers/net/ethernet/huawei/hinic/hinic_hw_qp.h
index a0dc63a4bfc7..038522e202b6 100644
--- a/drivers/net/ethernet/huawei/hinic/hinic_hw_qp.h
+++ b/drivers/net/ethernet/huawei/hinic/hinic_hw_qp.h
@@ -160,7 +160,7 @@ void hinic_task_set_inner_l3(struct hinic_sq_task *task,
 			     u32 network_len);
 
 void hinic_task_set_tunnel_l4(struct hinic_sq_task *task,
-			      enum hinic_l4_offload_type l4_type,
+			      enum hinic_l4_tunnel_type l4_type,
 			      u32 tunnel_len);
 
 void hinic_set_cs_inner_l4(struct hinic_sq_task *task,
-- 
2.25.1



diff --git a/drivers/net/ethernet/huawei/hinic/hinic_hw_qp.c b/drivers/net/ethernet/huawei/hinic/hinic_hw_qp.c
index 967c993d5303..bbf9bdd0ee3e 100644
--- a/drivers/net/ethernet/huawei/hinic/hinic_hw_qp.c
+++ b/drivers/net/ethernet/huawei/hinic/hinic_hw_qp.c
@@ -532,7 +532,7 @@ void hinic_task_set_inner_l3(struct hinic_sq_task *task,
 }
 
 void hinic_task_set_tunnel_l4(struct hinic_sq_task *task,
-			      enum hinic_l4_offload_type l4_type,
+			      enum hinic_l4_tunnel_type l4_type,
 			      u32 tunnel_len)
 {
 	task->pkt_info2 |= HINIC_SQ_TASK_INFO2_SET(l4_type, TUNNEL_L4TYPE) |

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `hinic_hw_qp.h`**
   - The parameter type of the function `hinic_task_set_tunnel_l4` was changed from `enum hinic_l4_offload_type` to `enum hinic_l4_tunnel_type`.

2. **File: `hinic_hw_qp.c`**
   - Similarly, the parameter type of the function `hinic_task_set_tunnel_l4` was also changed from `enum hinic_l4_offload_type` to `enum hinic_l4_tunnel_type`.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modifications in both files are directly related as they ensure consistency in the function definition and its implementation. The change in the parameter type from `hinic_l4_offload_type` to `hinic_l4_tunnel_type` in the header file (`hinic_hw_qp.h`) is mirrored in the source file (`hinic_hw_qp.c`). This correction addresses a type mismatch that was causing a Clang warning about implicit conversion between different enumeration types, thereby fixing the underlying bug.
